brief: BONSAI GRAMMAR: plants grown from L-systems (Lindenmayer systems, as presented in Prusinkiewicz and Lindenmayer's 'The Algorithmic Beauty of Plants'), drawn by a 3D turtle (yaw, pitch, roll commands with [ ] branching) and rendered with depth-shaded tapered branches, leaves and blossoms (WebGL or Canvas 2D). Growth animates generation by generation; wind sways branches procedurally; a seasons slider changes foliage (spring blossom, summer green, autumn colour, bare winter). Ship at least 6 correct classic grammars (for example the fractal plant X -> F+[[X]-X]-F[-FX]+X, F -> FF; a bush; a 3D tree with tropism) plus a live rule editor with validation and clear error messages. Controls: iterations, branch angle, length decay, tropism (gravity bend), random seed for stochastic rules, orbit camera. Readouts: string length and segment count, with a safety cap so huge expansions never freeze the page. The first frame shows a mature tree in a pot.
